pages.text: A Material Interface is a crafting component. Material Interfaces are generally used in devices that need to read data from a specially prepared Radiant Quartz crystal.$(br2)Material Interfaces can be used to upgrade $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/radianttrove)Radiant Troves$(/l).$(br2)Material Interfaces can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).

$()$(italic) My tests with the mysterious crystal indicate that each facet, no matter how small or how minutely different from its neighbors, lead to a different part of this strange Otherwhere. $()$(br2)$()$(italic) The implications of this property are staggering for compact storage. $()
$()$(italic) Or at least, they would be, if the slightest touch didn’t change what part of Otherwhere the crystal is pointing to. A pity, too. I was rather fond of that spoon. $()

$()$(italic) I believe a device meant to emulate the $()Unseen Hand of the Master$()$(italic) spell, along with some minor divination enchantments for good measure, might have the potential to correct for these instabilities and maintain a consistent location and frequency in Othewhere. $()$(br2)$()$(bold) Research Journal of Sharaveda $()$(br2)...1665, Autumn’s Birth
